observations.why: The directive frames a mandatory security gate as a precondition for deployment, appealing to conservation (security, control) and competence (quality of craft in the release process).

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: The assertive justifies the gate by citing a past security failure, appealing to conservation as the motive — preventing recurrence of unsafe deployments.
The gate summary restates the security requirement as a binding condition, carrying conservation as the appealed-to good.
Extending the gate's scope to both staging and production reinforces conservation — security coverage across all deployment environments.
Assigning ownership of the gate appeals to conservation — accountability as a mechanism for maintaining security and control.
